Hi Sophie — welcome! A few details to make the internal routing smoother:

- AWS vs Azure vs GCP: AWS Marketplace requires the Seller ID/Listing SKU on the PO; Azure uses the Publisher ID and a partner agreement route; GCP has a separate vendor onboarding team and may require a different banking setup depending on currency. If you plan to go to multiple marketplaces, we can do a staged approach (AWS first).
- For AWS: please include this string on the PO once I confirm the AWS Seller ID: REDW-INFR-000987 (placeholder until I confirm with Seller Central).
- Payment terms & invoices: Redwood supports Net30 by default for marketplace SAAS purchases; we can request Net45/Net60 for enterprise procurements via a credit review.

Tentative timeline (AWS only):
- Day 0: Receive PO + vendor paperwork (W-9)
- Day 1–3: KYC & banking verify
- Day 3–7: Seller Central listing activation (assuming no escalations)
- Day 7+: Billing & invoicing operational

I also added a link to the HubSpot deal so procurement and sales teams can track: https://hubspot.company/deals/HM-202611-FM01

Let me know if you can send the PO today.
